sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是Benjamin Poulin，我是Mark Ronson，欢迎收听《The Reframers》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其背后文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 即使是在我还在夜店当DJ的黑胶唱片时代，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你每天晚上都要带上300件最珍贵的宝贝去工作，把DJ台变成一个充满50年历史精美文物的流动博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼（Audemars Piguet）出品的《The Reframers》吧。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的Michael Barbaro。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《The Daily》节目。

sentences.en: Today, Congress revolts and approves sanctions against Russia.
sentences.zh: 今天，国会发起反抗，批准了对俄罗斯的制裁。

sentences.en: The press secretary quits.
sentences.zh: 白宫新闻秘书辞职。

sentences.en: The White House looks to discredit the special prosecutor investigating the president.
sentences.zh: 白宫试图抹黑调查总统的特别检察官。

sentences.en: And the president says he has complete power to pardon family, aides, and maybe even himself.
sentences.zh: 总统声称他有权赦免家人、助手，甚至可能赦免他自己。

sentences.en: Making sense of a busy few days at the White House.
sentences.zh: 带你理清白宫这几天发生的忙乱事件。

sentences.en: It's Monday, July 24th.
sentences.zh: 今天是7月24日，星期一。

sentences.en: The House and Senate have agreed to a deal that could send a new bill to the president's desk before the end of the month.
sentences.zh: 众议院和参议院已达成协议，可能在本月底前将一项新法案提交给总统签署。

sentences.en: It would slap Russia with new sanctions and give Congress veto power over easing sanctions against Moscow.
sentences.zh: 该法案将对俄罗斯实施新的制裁，并赋予国会否决放宽对俄制裁的权力。

sentences.en: Glenn Thrush, let's start with the news over the weekend that Congress has agreed on legislation to punish Russia for its interference in the election.
sentences.zh: Glenn Thrush，我们先从周末的新闻说起，国会已就惩罚俄罗斯干预大选的立法达成一致。

sentences.en: And comes despite lobbying by the White House to water down sanctions on Russia.
sentences.zh: 尽管白宫一直在游说，试图淡化对俄制裁。

sentences.en: What was the controversy around that with the White House?
sentences.zh: 白宫在这方面有什么争议吗？

sentences.en: Look, Michael, it's not at all clear that the president wants to punish Russia anymore.
sentences.zh: 听着，Michael，现在完全不清楚总统是否还想惩罚俄罗斯。

sentences.en: You know, we had that second undisclosed meeting at the G20 in Hamburg, in which it appears that the president and Vladimir Putin talked about a lot of things.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们在汉堡G20峰会上进行了第二次未公开的会晤，看起来总统和弗拉基米尔·普京谈了很多事情。

sentences.en: But the president emerged, again, really toting the softest line on Moscow of anybody in his administration.
sentences.zh: 但总统再次露面时，他表现出的对莫斯科的态度，实际上是他政府中所有人里最软弱的。

sentences.en: And it wasn't at all clear until this weekend that the House and Senate were really willing to go hard on Russia.
sentences.zh: 直到这个周末，还不清楚众议院和参议院是否真的愿意对俄罗斯采取强硬态度。

sentences.en: So this, I wouldn't say, is a rebuke to the president.
sentences.zh: 所以，我不会说这是对总统的斥责。

sentences.en: But it is very clearly another example of policy being made on the Hill as opposed to being made in the West Wing.
sentences.zh: 但这显然是政策制定权在国会山，而不是在白宫西翼的又一个例子。

sentences.en: Look, the administration is supportive of being tough on Russia, particularly in putting these sanctions in place.
sentences.zh: 看，政府支持对俄罗斯强硬，特别是在实施这些制裁方面。

sentences.en: On Sunday, Sarah Huckabee Sanders said the White House was likely to sign on with that.
sentences.zh: 周日，Sarah Huckabee Sanders表示白宫很可能会签署该法案。

sentences.en: And it clearly wasn't something the president and his team thought was prudent to battle on.
sentences.zh: 显然，总统和他的团队认为在这件事上抗争并不明智。

sentences.en: So I think they are going to go along with Congress.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为他们会顺从国会的意愿。

sentences.en: And we support where the legislation is now.
sentences.zh: 我们支持目前的立法内容。

sentences.en: We'll continue working with the House and Senate to put those tough sanctions in place on Russia until the situation in Ukraine is fully resolved.
sentences.zh: 我们将继续与众议院和参议院合作，对俄罗斯实施严厉制裁，直到乌克兰局势得到彻底解决。

sentences.en: And it certainly isn't right now.
sentences.zh: 而目前显然还没有解决。

sentences.en: So the president will sign that bill.
sentences.zh: 所以总统会签署那项法案。

sentences.en: That's a little news.
sentences.zh: 这就是一点新闻。

sentences.en: Does this mean, do you think, Glenn, that members of Congress are getting more serious about Russia and the investigation into its ties to the Trump campaign and administration,
sentences.zh: Glenn，你认为这意味着国会议员们在俄罗斯问题，以及对俄罗斯与特朗普竞选团队及政府之间联系的调查上，变得更加认真了吗？

sentences.en: whether the president likes it or not?
sentences.zh: 不管总统喜不喜欢？

sentences.en: And he's made pretty clear that he doesn't.
sentences.zh: 而且他已经很明确地表示他不喜欢。

sentences.en: The president is stuck in this mire over Russia.
sentences.zh: 总统深陷俄罗斯问题的泥潭之中。

sentences.en: Republican members of Congress don't want to get dragged into the quicksand with him.
sentences.zh: 国会的共和党议员们不想和他一起陷入流沙。

sentences.en: That is really clear.
sentences.zh: 这一点非常清楚。

sentences.en: They want to support him insofar as they're able to prop him up and have a unified Republican front on their agenda items, particularly tax reform.
sentences.zh: 他们想在力所能及的范围内支持他，以维持共和党在议程项目（特别是税制改革）上的统一战线。

sentences.en: But they are not, not, not, not in any way going to adopt his position on Russia.
sentences.zh: 但他们绝不会、绝不会、绝不会、绝不会在任何方面采纳他在俄罗斯问题上的立场。

sentences.en: They don't want to be associated with him.
sentences.zh: 他们不想与他扯上关系。

sentences.en: So they're getting very used to staking out positions that are at variance with him and then running away from reporters as they chase him in the halls of Congress,
sentences.zh: 所以他们已经习惯于表明与他不同的立场，然后在国会大厅里被记者追问时躲避他们，

sentences.en: asking them whether or not they support the president.
sentences.zh: 问他们是否支持总统。

sentences.en: So they're, they're willing to pick fights with him, but they don't want to be seen as doing it too deliberately or with too much delight.
sentences.zh: 所以他们愿意与他发生争执，但他们不想表现得太刻意或太乐见其成。

sentences.en: What they have established really over the past two months, since we started this healthcare thing, is a permission structure to defy him on policy,
sentences.zh: 他们真正建立起来的，是在过去两个月，自从我们开始搞医改以来，一种在政策上反抗他的许可结构，

sentences.en: yet to unify with him in terms of the larger political goals.
sentences.zh: 但在更大的政治目标上又与他保持统一。

sentences.en: That's really, really important.
sentences.zh: 这一点真的非常非常重要。

sentences.en: What they have done, and it's funny, we talk about Bill Clinton doing this as president.
sentences.zh: 他们所做的事情很有趣，我们谈论过比尔·克林顿担任总统时也这样做过。

sentences.en: Well, congressional leaders are doing this now.
sentences.zh: 现在国会领导人也在这样做。

sentences.en: They're compartmentalizing.
sentences.zh: 他们在进行分门别类。

sentences.en: They are saying we support the president generically and oppose him on specific policy issues.
sentences.zh: 他们说，我们笼统地支持总统，但在具体的政策问题上反对他。

sentences.en: I'm thinking also, Glenn, of the latest developments with Robert Mueller, the special prosecutor in the Russia investigation.
sentences.zh: Glenn，我还想到了罗伯特·穆勒（Robert Mueller）的最新进展，他是俄罗斯调查案的特别检察官。

sentences.en: We've been reporting that the president is unhappy with Mueller because of the scope of his investigation and that the White House has been making moves to try to discredit him.
sentences.zh: 我们一直在报道总统对穆勒不满，因为调查范围太广，白宫一直在采取行动试图抹黑他。

sentences.en: Does it actually seem possible that the president might fire his special prosecutor?
sentences.zh: 总统真的有可能解雇他的特别检察官吗？

sentences.en: The president of the United States views anyone who works for him, even constitutional officers of the law, like Mueller, like Sessions, like Rod Rosenstein, the second,
sentences.zh: 美国总统看待任何为他工作的人，甚至是像穆勒、塞申斯（Sessions）、罗德·罗森斯坦（Rod Rosenstein）这样的宪法法律官员，

sentences.en: number two at the Justice Department, like former FBI Director James Comey.
sentences.zh: 司法部的二号人物，以及前联邦调查局局长詹姆斯·科米（James Comey），

sentences.en: He views them as personal employees, and that changes the dynamic altogether.
sentences.zh: 他把他们视为私人雇员，这完全改变了动态。

sentences.en: So he doesn't view Jeff Sessions as the attorney general of the United States in all capitals.
sentences.zh: 所以他并不把杰夫·塞申斯看作是全称的“美国司法部长”。

sentences.en: He views him as the guy I let be attorney general of the United States.
sentences.zh: 他把他看作是“我允许他担任美国司法部长的那个人”。

sentences.en: And he views Bob Mueller as the guy who Jeff Sessions let be the special counsel.
sentences.zh: 他把鲍勃·穆勒看作是“杰夫·塞申斯允许他担任特别检察官的那个人”。

sentences.en: In the president's mind, Bob Mueller works for him.
sentences.zh: 在总统看来，鲍勃·穆勒是为他工作的。

sentences.en: And if he believes that Bob Mueller is moving this investigation into areas that he is not comfortable with,
sentences.zh: 如果他认为鲍勃·穆勒正在将调查引向他不舒服的领域，

sentences.en: I do think he will flout his members of his own party and get rid of him.
sentences.zh: 我确实认为他会无视本党成员的意见，把他除掉。

sentences.en: So what you're saying is that it's highly conceivable that the president could fire Robert Mueller.
sentences.zh: 所以你的意思是，总统解雇罗伯特·穆勒是完全可以想象的。

sentences.en: But how would Congress react to that if he did it?
sentences.zh: 但如果他真的这么做了，国会会有什么反应？

sentences.en: Michael, the big question here, and maybe the defining question of this presidency, is what is the red line for Mitch McConnell and Paul Ryan?
sentences.zh: Michael，这里最大的问题，也许是这届总统任期内决定性的问题，就是米奇·麦康奈尔（Mitch McConnell）和保罗·瑞安（Paul Ryan）的底线在哪里？

sentences.en: How far would Donald Trump have to go before they would act to oppose him in a significant way on a constitutional basis?
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普到底要走多远，他们才会采取行动，在宪法基础上以重大方式反对他？

sentences.en: That is the fundamental question.
sentences.zh: 这是根本问题。

sentences.en: And as President Trump has shown, he is a boundaries tester.
sentences.zh: 正如特朗普总统所展示的那样，他是一个边界测试者。

sentences.en: So I have every expectation that over the course of the next several months, he will push and probe and attempt to figure out how far he can move things.
sentences.zh: 所以我完全预期在接下来的几个月里，他会不断推动和试探，试图弄清楚他能把事情推进到什么程度。

sentences.en: Because he's not playing by a conventional playbook.
sentences.zh: 因为他不按常规出牌。

sentences.en: And he views this as an existential battle.
sentences.zh: 他把这视为一场生存之战。

sentences.en: This isn't about his role with respect to Congress.
sentences.zh: 这与他相对于国会的角色无关。

sentences.en: This is about the legitimacy of his election and his viability as a president.
sentences.zh: 这关乎他选举的合法性和他作为总统的生存能力。

sentences.en: So I don't know how he's going to act.
sentences.zh: 所以我不知道他会怎么做。

sentences.en: They don't know how he's going to act.
sentences.zh: 他们也不知道他会怎么做。

sentences.en: And the real big question here is, what will Congress do if he goes to an extreme like firing Mueller?
sentences.zh: 这里真正的大问题是，如果他走极端，比如解雇穆勒，国会会怎么做？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Slow news day.
sentences.zh: 新闻平淡的一天。

sentences.en: So something else happened over the weekend.
sentences.zh: 所以周末还发生了别的事。

sentences.en: Good afternoon.
sentences.zh: 下午好。

sentences.en: I'd like to read a statement from the president on the resignation of Press Secretary Sean Spicer.
sentences.zh: 我想宣读一份总统关于新闻秘书肖恩·斯派塞（Sean Spicer）辞职的声明。

sentences.en: Sean Spicer resigned as White House Press Secretary.
sentences.zh: 肖恩·斯派塞辞去了白宫新闻秘书一职。

sentences.en: What's the backstory?
sentences.zh: 背景是什么？

sentences.en: I wish him continued success as he moves on to pursue new opportunities.
sentences.zh: 我祝愿他在追求新机遇的过程中继续取得成功。

sentences.en: Just look at his great television ratings.
sentences.zh: 看看他那出色的电视收视率就知道了。

sentences.en: Well, Sean Spicer had been on the way out for basically two and a half or three months.
sentences.zh: 嗯，肖恩·斯派塞基本上在两三个月前就已经要走人了。

sentences.en: The president had really hung him with a tag.
sentences.zh: 总统确实给他贴上了一个标签。

sentences.en: And this is pretty unrecoverable of not being, quote unquote, tough.
sentences.zh: 而且这个标签是无法挽回的，那就是不够“强硬”。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: The president said Spicer was not tough.
sentences.zh: 总统说斯派塞不够强硬。

sentences.en: He did not think Spicer was tough enough.
sentences.zh: 他认为斯派塞不够强硬。

sentences.en: Here's an insight.
sentences.zh: 这里有个内幕。

sentences.en: Spicer pulled all these briefings off camera about a month ago.
sentences.zh: 大约一个月前，斯派塞把所有这些简报会都改成了非公开拍摄。

sentences.en: Most of the briefings off camera.
sentences.zh: 大部分简报会都不允许拍摄。

sentences.en: A lot of us assumed, and I think the punditocracy assumed, that this was an assault on broadcast journalism.
sentences.zh: 我们大多数人，我想评论界也认为，这是对广播新闻业的攻击。

sentences.en: And I think the White House portrayed it as that.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为白宫也是这样描述的。

sentences.en: In fact, most of it was Spicer not wanting to be on camera so that Donald Trump wouldn't yell at him about his performance.
sentences.zh: 事实上，大部分原因是因为斯派塞不想上镜，这样唐纳德·特朗普就不会因为他的表现而对他大吼大叫。

sentences.en: Wait, let me slow this down.
sentences.zh: 等等，让我慢点说。

sentences.en: That is a fact.
sentences.zh: 这是事实。

sentences.en: You're saying the reason why the White House Press Secretary asked that cameras not be rolling and recording the news conferences that he oversees is because he didn't want the president of the United States,
sentences.zh: 你是说白宫新闻秘书要求在新闻发布会期间不要开摄像机录制，是因为他不想让美国总统，

sentences.en: his boss, to see him conducting the business of being press secretary.
sentences.zh: 也就是他的老板，看到他履行新闻秘书职责的样子？

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Press Secretary Sean Spicer ignited a firestorm during his daily briefing by suggesting not only that Bashar al-Assad is worse than Adolf Hitler,
sentences.zh: 新闻秘书肖恩·斯派塞在每日简报会上引发了一场风暴，他不仅暗示巴沙尔·阿萨德比阿道夫·希特勒更糟糕，

sentences.en: but that Hitler did not use chemical weapons during World War II.
sentences.zh: 还说希特勒在二战期间没有使用化学武器。

sentences.en: And the president agreed with that.
sentences.zh: 而总统同意这一点。

sentences.en: The president thought the optics weren't great, and he was on board with that.
sentences.zh: 总统认为视觉效果不太好，但他对此表示赞同。

sentences.en: And frankly, I mistakenly used an inappropriate and insensitive reference to the Holocaust, for which, frankly, there is no comparison.
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，我错误地使用了关于大屠杀的不恰当且不敏感的引用，坦率地说，这根本无法比较。

sentences.en: And for that, I apologize.
sentences.zh: 对此，我表示道歉。

sentences.en: It was a mistake to do that.
sentences.zh: 这样做是一个错误。

sentences.en: But the principal prime mover of that decision amounted to Sean Spicer not wanting his boss watching him work.
sentences.zh: 但做出这一决定的主要推动力，归根结底是肖恩·斯派塞不想让他的老板看着他工作。

sentences.en: That is a fact.
sentences.zh: 这是事实。

sentences.en: David, I think the bigger question tonight is not whether Sean Spicer thinks he has a credibility problem.
sentences.zh: David，我认为今晚更大的问题不是肖恩·斯派塞是否认为自己有信誉问题。

sentences.en: It's whether the president thinks Sean Spicer has a credibility problem.
sentences.zh: 而是总统是否认为肖恩·斯派塞有信誉问题。

sentences.en: Glenn, what you're describing sounds like a deteriorating relationship that has not been good for some time between the president and his press secretary.
sentences.zh: Glenn，你所描述的听起来像是一种恶化的关系，总统和他的新闻秘书之间这种关系已经不佳有一段时间了。

sentences.en: And steps that they're taking to minimize the conflict.
sentences.zh: 以及他们为减少冲突而采取的步骤。

sentences.en: So what exactly changed in the past 48 hours or so that made Sean Spicer want to quit his job?
sentences.zh: 那么在过去48小时左右，究竟发生了什么变化，让肖恩·斯派塞想要辞职？

sentences.en: On Friday morning at around 10 a.m., the president offered Anthony Scaramucci the communications director job.
sentences.zh: 周五上午10点左右，总统向安东尼·斯卡拉穆奇（Anthony Scaramucci）提供了通讯主管的工作。

sentences.en: And at around 11 a.m., Sean Spicer went into the Oval Office.
sentences.zh: 大约上午11点，肖恩·斯派塞走进了椭圆形办公室。

sentences.en: The president said how much he wanted Sean to stay, but also informed him that Sean would now be reporting to Scaramucci.
sentences.zh: 总统说他有多希望肖恩留下来，但也通知他，肖恩现在要向斯卡拉穆奇汇报工作。

sentences.en: And this wasn't like a normal comms director job.
sentences.zh: 这不像普通的通讯主管工作。

sentences.en: Scaramucci would really run the operation and Sean would become a subordinate.
sentences.zh: 斯卡拉穆奇将真正运营这个部门，而肖恩将成为下属。

sentences.en: Sean Spicer said, no, I think this is going to contribute to the chaos that's been going on.
sentences.zh: 肖恩·斯派塞说，不，我认为这会加剧一直以来的混乱。

sentences.en: And he articulated it in the bluntest way possible to the president that he thought Scaramucci would just encourage his pre-existing instincts and would create an even less professional communications operation.
sentences.zh: 他以最直白的方式向总统表达了他的观点，他认为斯卡拉穆奇只会助长他已有的本能，并会创造出一个更不专业的通讯运作。

sentences.en: And Spicer said, nope, this is it for me.
sentences.zh: 斯派塞说，不，对我来说到此为止了。

sentences.en: Oh, you can't hear me?
sentences.zh: 哦，你听不到我说话吗？

sentences.en: I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 抱歉。

sentences.en: Better?
sentences.zh: 好点了吗？

sentences.en: Better now?
sentences.zh: 现在好点了吗？

sentences.en: Better now?
sentences.zh: 现在好点了吗？

sentences.en: I'm going to start over.
sentences.zh: 我要重新开始。

sentences.en: I want to make a couple of statements.
sentences.zh: 我想发表几点声明。

sentences.en: The first thing I want to say is I want to thank personally Sean Spicer, not only on behalf of myself, the president, the administration, but Sean is a true American patriot.
sentences.zh: 我要说的第一件事是，我要亲自感谢肖恩·斯派塞，不仅代表我自己、总统、政府，肖恩是一位真正的美国爱国者。

sentences.en: He's a military serviceman.
sentences.zh: 他是一位军人。

sentences.en: He's got a great family.
sentences.zh: 他有一个很棒的家庭。

sentences.en: And he's done an amazing job.
sentences.zh: 他做得非常出色。

sentences.en: This is obviously a difficult situation to be in.
sentences.zh: 这显然是一个困难的处境。

sentences.en: And I applaud his efforts here.
sentences.zh: 我为他在这里所做的努力鼓掌。

sentences.en: And I love the guy.
sentences.zh: 我爱这个家伙。

sentences.en: And I wish him well.
sentences.zh: 我祝他一切顺利。

sentences.en: And I hope he goes on to make a tremendous amount of money.
sentences.zh: 我希望他以后能赚到一大笔钱。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, Glenn, who is Anthony Scaramucci?
sentences.zh: 那么，Glenn，安东尼·斯卡拉穆奇是谁？

sentences.en: Anthony Scaramucci is a guy who has been hanging around Trump world for a long time.
sentences.zh: 安东尼·斯卡拉穆奇是一个在特朗普圈子里混了很久的人。

sentences.en: He is a Harvard Law graduate.
sentences.zh: 他是哈佛法学院的毕业生。

sentences.en: He's 53 years old.
sentences.zh: 他今年53岁。

sentences.en: He graduated Harvard Law, we should say, two years before Barack Obama.
sentences.zh: 我们应该说，他比巴拉克·奥巴马早两年从哈佛法学院毕业。

sentences.en: He is from Long Island.
sentences.zh: 他来自长岛。

sentences.en: He is Italian and has all of the intonations and colloquial expressions that go along with that.
sentences.zh: 他是意大利裔，带有所有与之相关的语调和口语表达。

sentences.en: He's a wealthy financier.
sentences.zh: 他是一位富有的金融家。

sentences.en: He ran a hedge fund.
sentences.zh: 他经营过一家对冲基金。

sentences.en: In fact, one of the reasons he didn't make it into the administration in the first place was because he was seeking to sell it to the Chinese.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他最初没能进入政府部门的原因之一，就是他当时正试图把基金卖给中国人。

sentences.en: He still has to clear that hurdle.
sentences.zh: 他仍需跨过那道坎。

sentences.en: But he really swam in a lot of the same fishbowl that Trump did in New York, attending parties, part of the Page Six Glitterati.
sentences.zh: 但他确实和特朗普在纽约混迹于同一个圈子，参加各种派对，是《第六页》名流圈的一员。

sentences.en: So this is a guy who understands where Trump came from and I think has a sense of where Trump wants to go.
sentences.zh: 所以，这是一个了解特朗普出身的人，而且我认为他也能感知到特朗普想去向何方。

sentences.en: And to use a Wall Street expression, there might be an arbitrage spread between how well we are doing and how well some of you guys think we're doing.
sentences.zh: 用华尔街的术语来说，我们表现得有多好，与你们当中一些人认为我们表现得有多好之间，可能存在着某种套利价差。

sentences.en: And we're going to work hard to close that spread.
sentences.zh: 我们将努力缩小这一价差。

sentences.en: And so I'm done.
sentences.zh: 好了，我说完了。

sentences.en: I'll take the question.
sentences.zh: 我来回答问题。

sentences.en: Glenn, what is Anthony Scaramucci saying he's going to do differently when it comes to how the president is portrayed by the White House?
sentences.zh: 格伦，安东尼·斯卡拉穆奇说，在白宫如何塑造总统形象方面，他打算做出什么不同的改变？

sentences.en: Oh, he's not going to do anything differently, Michael.
sentences.zh: 哦，迈克尔，他什么都不会做改变。

sentences.en: He's going to say it differently.
sentences.zh: 他只是会换一种说法。

sentences.en: That's what the deal is here.
sentences.zh: 这就是这里的交易。

sentences.en: I mean,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，

sentences.en: one of the really remarkable components of this was him coming out into the briefing room and essentially saying that the big problem we all had was that Donald Trump's message isn't getting through.
sentences.zh: 这件事真正引人注目的部分之一，是他来到简报室，本质上是说我们大家面临的大问题是唐纳德·特朗普的信息没有传达出去。

sentences.en: I think there's been at times a disconnect between the way we see the president and how much we love the president and the way some of you perhaps see the president.
sentences.zh: 我认为，有时我们看待总统的方式、我们对总统的喜爱程度，与你们当中一些人看待总统的方式之间存在脱节。

sentences.en: And I certainly see the American people probably see the president the way I do.
sentences.zh: 我当然认为，美国人民看待总统的方式可能和我一样。

sentences.en: But we want to get that message out there.
sentences.zh: 但我们想把那个信息传达出去。

sentences.en: And that Sean had done a great job.
sentences.zh: 而且肖恩做得很好。

sentences.en: But his whole thing was to make sure that the Donald Trump that Scaramucci knows and loves.
sentences.zh: 但他全部的重点是确保大家看到的是斯卡拉穆奇所了解和热爱的那个唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: And by the way, Scaramucci used the word love, I think, four times with connection to Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，我想斯卡拉穆奇在提到唐纳德·特朗普时用了四次“热爱”这个词。

sentences.en: That he loves him.
sentences.zh: 他热爱他。

sentences.en: I love the president.
sentences.zh: 我热爱总统。

sentences.en: He loves him.
sentences.zh: 他热爱他。

sentences.en: And the basic thing that he really needed to do was to communicate this message better.
sentences.zh: 他真正需要做的基本事情就是更好地传达这个信息。

sentences.en: And Scaramucci essentially established or reiterated the basic relationship that Sean Spicer had with the president, which is,
sentences.zh: 斯卡拉穆奇本质上确立或重申了肖恩·斯派塞与总统之间的基本关系，即：

sentences.en: I am there to communicate with the president and then communicate what I've communicated with the president to the media.
sentences.zh: 我负责与总统沟通，然后将我与总统沟通的内容传达给媒体。

sentences.en: The problem is not communication.
sentences.zh: 问题不在于沟通。

sentences.en: The problem is, for instance, on Sunday, we find out that Jared Kushner didn't disclose financial transactions.
sentences.zh: 问题在于，例如周日，我们发现贾里德·库什纳没有披露财务交易。

sentences.en: We found out last week about a separate meeting that the president had with Vladimir Putin, in which they discussed, quote unquote, adoptions, which is a code word for sanctions.
sentences.zh: 上周我们发现总统与弗拉基米尔·普京举行了一次单独会晤，他们讨论了所谓的“收养”问题，这是制裁的代号。

sentences.en: And then he sits down with us and he tells us offhandedly that he's really not so sure about his own attorney general.
sentences.zh: 然后他坐下来，随口告诉我们他对自己任命的司法部长不太确定。

sentences.en: There's not a communications problem.
sentences.zh: 这根本不是沟通问题。

sentences.en: The issue here is you have the president of the United States saying and doing what he wants to do and his press shop scampering after him trying to explain it to the rest of the world.
sentences.zh: 这里的问题是，美国总统想说什么就说什么，想做什么就做什么，而他的新闻团队则在他身后忙乱地试图向世界其他地方解释这一切。

sentences.en: So there's not a fundamental difference.
sentences.zh: 所以，这并没有本质上的区别。

sentences.en: What is the first thing you're going to change to try to right this ship and put it on a course?
sentences.zh: 你打算采取的第一项改变措施是什么，以试图纠正这艘船并使其走上正轨？

sentences.en: Again, I take issue with that.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，我对此有不同意见。

sentences.en: I think the ship is going in the right direction.
sentences.zh: 我认为这艘船正朝着正确的方向前进。

sentences.en: I think we've got to just radio signal the direction very, very clearly.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们只需要非常、非常清晰地发出航向信号。

sentences.en: I like the team.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这个团队。

sentences.en: Let me rephrase that.
sentences.zh: 让我换个说法。

sentences.en: I love the team.
sentences.zh: 我热爱这个团队。

sentences.en: The one thing I would say is this.
sentences.zh: 我要说的一点是这个。

sentences.en: Scaramucci, because he occupies a higher stature in the food chain, at least right now with Trump, might have the capacity, might,
sentences.zh: 斯卡拉穆奇，因为他在食物链中的地位更高，至少目前在特朗普身边是这样，他可能有能力，可能，

sentences.en: to turn to the president and occasionally tell him not to do stuff.
sentences.zh: 去告诉总统，偶尔让他别做某些事。

sentences.en: And so I'm an incrementaliSt.
sentences.zh: 所以我是一个渐进主义者。

sentences.en: Most entrepreneurs you will find are incrementalists.
sentences.zh: 你会发现大多数企业家都是渐进主义者。

sentences.en: To say something overly bold or overly dramatic is unfair.
sentences.zh: 说一些过于大胆或过于戏剧化的话是不公平的。

sentences.en: What good entrepreneurs do is they start the day and they go through the process.
sentences.zh: 优秀的创业者所做的是从一天开始，按部就班地完成流程。

sentences.en: The Navy SEALs would tell you that if you want to eat an elephant, you've got to eat it one bite at a time.
sentences.zh: 美国海豹突击队会告诉你，如果你想吃掉一头大象，你必须一口一口地吃。

sentences.en: And Sarah and I are going to do that together.
sentences.zh: 萨拉和我将共同完成这一点。

sentences.en: So all of this has thrust Sarah Huckabee Sanders, who was Sean's deputy, into the press secretary role.
sentences.zh: 所以这一切把曾是肖恩副手的萨拉·赫卡比·桑德斯推向了新闻秘书的角色。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Obviously, I would have been happy for him to stay up here all day and continue to exhaust all of your questions.
sentences.zh: 显然，我很乐意让他一直站在这里，继续回答你们所有的问题。

sentences.en: But one, I figure I probably should answer a couple today.
sentences.zh: 但第一，我想我今天大概应该回答几个问题。

sentences.en: Sarah is a lot more polite.
sentences.zh: 萨拉礼貌多了。

sentences.en: But she also is very tight with information.
sentences.zh: 但她对信息也把控得很严。

sentences.en: And one thing we've all noticed in briefings with Sarah is we actually get less information out of Sarah than we did from Sean.
sentences.zh: 我们都注意到的一点是，在萨拉的简报会上，我们从她那里得到的信息实际上比从肖恩那里得到的还要少。

sentences.en: Can you clarify where the president stands on the issue of pardons?
sentences.zh: 你能澄清一下总统在赦免问题上的立场吗？

sentences.en: Is he considering pardons for figures in the Russia investigation?
sentences.zh: 他是否在考虑赦免俄罗斯调查中的相关人物？

sentences.en: Does the president believe that he has the power to pardon himself?
sentences.zh: 总统是否认为他有权赦免自己？

sentences.en: Look, I'd refer you to the comments that have already been made by the outside counsel in terms of their actions.
sentences.zh: 看，关于外部法律顾问的行动，我建议你们参考他们已经发表的评论。

sentences.en: So, Glenn, let's turn back finally to Russia.
sentences.zh: 那么，格伦，最后让我们回到俄罗斯问题上。

sentences.en: On Sunday, the new White House communications director, Anthony Scaramucci, had to explain something else that happened over this weekend,
sentences.zh: 周日，新任白宫通讯联络主任安东尼·斯卡拉穆奇不得不解释这个周末发生的另一件事，

sentences.en: which was that the president tweeted about his power to issue pardons.
sentences.zh: 那就是总统发推文谈到了他发布赦免令的权力。

sentences.en: What did the president say?
sentences.zh: 总统说了什么？

sentences.en: And do we know what he meant?
sentences.zh: 我们知道他是什么意思吗？

sentences.en: He essentially said that everybody knows that I have the power to completely pardon people, to use it without restraint, essentially.
sentences.zh: 他基本上是说，大家都知道我有权完全赦免他人，基本上可以不受限制地使用这种权力。

sentences.en: Just kind of in passing in a tweet.
sentences.zh: 只是在推文中顺便提了一下。

sentences.en: And that was really one of the first articulations that he was thinking about it a lot.
sentences.zh: 这确实是他第一次明确表达他一直在考虑这个问题。

sentences.en: We know from the reporting that there are people who are allied with him who are looking to attack Bob Mueller, the special counsel.
sentences.zh: 我们从报道中得知，有一些与他结盟的人正寻求攻击特别检察官鲍勃·穆勒。

sentences.en: But if he's thinking about pardons, and this is a week in which we are likely to see some sort of testimony from Jared Kushner and his son, Donald Jr.,
sentences.zh: 但如果他在考虑赦免，而且这一周我们很可能会看到贾里德·库什纳和他的儿子小唐纳德的一些证词，

sentences.en: with regard to these meetings that we've heard so much about.
sentences.zh: 关于我们听说了那么多的那些会议。

sentences.en: With Russians, right?
sentences.zh: 和俄罗斯人，对吧？

sentences.en: If he's talking about pardons on the weekend before his son and son-in-law are due to testify before Congress, I think that speaks volumes about where his head is at.
sentences.zh: 如果他在他儿子和女婿定于国会作证前的周末谈论赦免，我认为这充分说明了他的想法。

sentences.en: And does he simply mean that he has the power to pardon anyone in his administration if the Russia investigation reaches a point where there are charges?
sentences.zh: 他是否仅仅是指，如果俄罗斯调查达到有指控的地步，他有权赦免他政府中的任何人？

sentences.en: Is it that straightforward?
sentences.zh: 就这么简单吗？

sentences.en: So from a legal perspective, the president has the right to pardon pretty much anyone.
sentences.zh: 从法律角度来看，总统几乎有权赦免任何人。

sentences.en: And that includes family members.
sentences.zh: 这包括家庭成员。

sentences.en: That includes people who worked for him.
sentences.zh: 这包括为他工作的人。

sentences.en: That includes people who are not in the administration.
sentences.zh: 这包括不在政府任职的人。

sentences.en: So this brings us back to the beginning of our conversation on Russia,
sentences.zh: 所以这让我们回到了关于俄罗斯对话的开头，

sentences.en: because on the same weekend that the president says that he accepts the need to punish Russia because of its meddling in the election and signs on to the congressional plan for sanctions,
sentences.zh: 因为就在总统表示他接受因俄罗斯干预选举而需要惩罚俄罗斯，并签署国会制裁计划的同一个周末，

sentences.en: he is simultaneously saying that he has the power to ensure that he can protect everyone on his team from potential charges of collusion with Russia if it gets to that.
sentences.zh: 他同时也在说，他有权确保自己能保护团队中的每个人免受可能与俄罗斯勾结的指控，如果事态发展到那一步的话。

sentences.en: Where does that leave us?
sentences.zh: 这让我们处于什么境地？

sentences.en: It leaves him in Gerald Ford territory.
sentences.zh: 这让他处于杰拉尔德·福特的境地。

sentences.en: My conscience tells me that only I, as president, have the constitutional power to firmly shut and seal this book.
sentences.zh: 我的良心告诉我，只有我作为总统，才拥有宪法权力来坚定地合上并封存这本书。

sentences.en: And that's kind of funny because the president visited the deck of the Gerald Ford over the weekend while he was talking about pardons.
sentences.zh: 这很有趣，因为总统在周末谈论赦免时，正好参观了杰拉尔德·福特号航空母舰的甲板。

sentences.en: I don't know if his staff knew that irony, but I noticed it.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他的工作人员是否知道这种讽刺，但我注意到了。

sentences.en: And by these presents do grant a full, free, and absolute pardon unto Richard Nixon for all offenses against the United States, which he, Richard Nixon,
sentences.zh: 并以此特赦理查德·尼克松，免除其对美国所犯下的、或可能犯下的所有罪行，即他，理查德·尼克松，

sentences.en: has committed or may have committed.
sentences.zh: 所犯下的或可能犯下的罪行。

sentences.en: Gerald Ford, when he pardoned Richard Nixon, that essentially led to his own political downfall.
sentences.zh: 杰拉尔德·福特在赦免理查德·尼克松时，这基本上导致了他自己的政治垮台。

sentences.en: So the president may have the legal right to pardon people, but the American people have proven over and over again that they don't like it when their presidents do that.
sentences.zh: 所以总统可能有法律权利赦免他人，但美国人民一次又一次地证明，他们不喜欢总统这样做。

sentences.en: I just think it would be a political cataclysm.
sentences.zh: 我只是认为那将是一场政治灾难。

sentences.en: Thank you, Glenn.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，格伦。

sentences.en: Really appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: No worries, man.
sentences.zh: 别客气，伙计。

sentences.en: Take care.
sentences.zh: 保重。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》报道商业和政策。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将采访商业、政治和文化领域一些最有影响力的领导人，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、扎伊兰·蒙达尼等等，地点是在纽约市举行的DealBook峰会舞台上。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经修饰的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at NYTimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在NYTimes.com上直播部分采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序观看，并获得一个月的免费访问权限，阅读我们所有的报道。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: Justine didn't have to die.
sentences.zh: 贾斯汀本不必死。

sentences.en: Based on the publicly released information from the BCA, this should not have happened.
sentences.zh: 根据明尼苏达州刑事逮捕局（BCA）公布的信息，这本不该发生。

sentences.en: The police chief in Minneapolis, Janae Hartow, has resigned at the request of the mayor,
sentences.zh: 明尼阿波利斯警察局长简·哈托已应市长要求辞职，

sentences.en: less than a week after one of the city's police officers fatally shot an unarmed woman who called 911 for help.
sentences.zh: 就在该市一名警察开枪打死一名拨打911求助的无辜女性不到一周后。

sentences.en: On our squad cars, you will find the words, to protect with courage and serve with compassion.
sentences.zh: 在我们的警车上，你会发现这样的话：以勇气保护，以同情服务。

sentences.en: This did not happen.
sentences.zh: 但这并没有发生。

sentences.en: The woman, Justine Damon, had recently moved from Australia to Minneapolis, where her fiancé lived.
sentences.zh: 这名女子贾斯汀·戴蒙德最近从澳大利亚搬到了未婚夫居住的明尼阿波利斯。

sentences.en: On the night of the shooting, she called the police to report a possible sexual assault behind their home.
sentences.zh: 枪击事件当晚，她报警举报自家后方可能发生的性侵犯。

sentences.en: She approached the police cruiser when it arrived and was shot in the abdomen by Officer Mohamed Noor.
sentences.zh: 当警车到达时，她走近警车，被穆罕默德·努尔警官击中腹部。

sentences.en: Noor has declined to speak to investigators about the shooting, and authorities have not provided an explanation for why he fired.
sentences.zh: 努尔拒绝就枪击事件与调查人员交谈，当局也没有解释他开枪的原因。

sentences.en: Both Noor and his partner had failed to turn on their body cameras.
sentences.zh: 努尔和他的搭档都没有打开随身摄像机。

sentences.en: My expectation is those cameras should be on.
sentences.zh: 我的期望是那些摄像机应该打开。

sentences.en: It is very clear in the policy when they should be on, and we're also going to enhance the policy.
sentences.zh: 政策中非常明确地规定了它们应该在什么时候开启，我们也将加强这一政策。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》，我们正在为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人宾至如归的建议。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会昏睡过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require, because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 我是指他们需要什么样的光线，因为这是一个非常具体的要求。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何地方收听《Wirecutter秀》。
